title: [Quality Management] Pass the single tracking record and clear the right filter in the purchase receipt subscriber
summary: Fixes two defects in the Quality Management purchase receipt subscriber. Filter cleanup now clears Quantity Handled (Base), so later posting event subscribers no longer get a filtered buffer. Inspection creation on the tracked path now receives the single-record buffer instead of the full posting buffer.
key_points: Filter cleanup clears Quantity Handled (Base) instead of Qty. to Invoice (Base)
Later posting events such as OnBeforeInsertTrackingSpecification no longer see a leftover filter on the tracking buffer
On the tracked path, subscribers of the OnBefore/OnAfterPurchaseAttemptCreateInspectionWithPurchaseLine events now see only the tracking record being inspected
The inspections created and the posted data are unchanged
Adds two tests and a manually bound test subscriber codeunit
